ev.q: The 14 patients lived in seven northwestern Indiana counties.
and only two had serologic evidence of B. microti infection.
Two patients (F and G) had B. microti IFA titers of 1:64
One patient (M) had positive C6 peptide EIA results
The median age was 46 years (range = 10–76 years); nine were female
This laboratory-based investigation does not suggest a cluster of Lyme disease or babesiosis cases

methods_quotes.q: CDC tested for Lyme disease by whole cell sonicate and C6 peptide EIAs followed by IgM and IgG immunoblots
demographic and clinical data were obtained from the CDC specimen submission form
